user.title: Sign in to TimeTree
user.description: Enter the e-mail and password of your TimeTree account. They are stored in Home Assistant so the session can be renewed automatically.

calendars.title: Choose calendars
calendars.description: Select the TimeTree calendars to add to Home Assistant. Each calendar becomes its own calendar entity. You can change the selection later via Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate TimeTree
reauth_confirm.description: The TimeTree session for {email} could not be renewed. Please enter the password again.

error.rate_limited: TimeTree is rate-limiting login attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
error.api_changed: TimeTree answered with an unknown data format. Please check for an integration update.
error.no_calendar_selected: Please select at least one calendar.

abort.already_configured: This TimeTree account is already configured. Use Configure on the existing entry to add or remove calendars.

init.title: TimeTree options
init.description: Calendars to sync and how often TimeTree is asked for changes. Deselected calendars are removed from Home Assistant together with their entities.

error.no_calendar_selected: Please select at least one calendar.

api_changed.title: TimeTree changed its web API
api_changed.description: TimeTree answered several times in a row with a data format this integration does not understand. This usually means TimeTree changed its (unofficial) web API. Your calendar keeps its last known events. Please check for an update of the TimeTree integration in HACS, or report it via the link below – attach the diagnostics download, it contains no personal data.
